title: Glycated peptides and machine learning predict cardiovascular disease in dialysis
summary: Mass spectrometry in 96 matched patients found 257 differentially abundant glycated peptides. Two peptides plus six clinical indicators were combined by elastic-net logistic regression, giving ROC-AUC 0.784 (training), 0.781 (internal test) and 0.822 in a multicentre external cohort of 102, higher than three published cardiovascular risk models. High-risk patients had higher 1-year CVD incidence in both validation cohorts.
ai_technology: Glmnet feature selection and elastic-net logistic regression on glycated peptides and clinical indicators

evidence.tested: Prospective derivation cohort (n = 240) and multicentre external validation (n = 102).
evidence.unknown: Modest AUC; small cohorts; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Penalized regression selects biomarkers and builds the model.
